unite_adi: UPPER SECONDARY-YEAR 9 (AFTER PREP)-LEVEL: B2.1 - THEME 3: PERSONAL LIFE & WELL-BEING

bolumler.ogrenmeKanitlari: PERFORMANCE ASSIGNMENT: Students will explore the theme ''Personal Life and Well-Being'' by reflecting on how to maintain a balance between physical health, mental health, emotional health, and social health. Students will write a ''Well-Being Journal'' that includes daily entries for describing activities or habits that promote each aspect of well-being. The assignment will conclude with a reflection on how these components interconnect and suggestions for improving personal well-being in daily life. The assignment will be evaluated by using a rubric scheme, a rating scale, and/or a marking scheme. Öğrenme-Öğretme Yaşantıları
bolumler.temelKabuller: This theme includes the concept of ''personal life and well-being with its components such as personal well-being with physical health (body and illnesses); personal well-being with mental and emotional health; personal well-being with social health'' and it is assumed that it could be present in almost all languages, with some exceptions. It is assumed that a student in the after prep year 9 of an upper secondary school may know what personal well-being with physical health (body and illnesses); personal well-being with mental and emotional health; personal well-being with social health mean in their as it is known that almost all people who start to learn a new language bring their pre-existing knowledge (in their own language) with them and transfer it to their new language learning context. However, they may not know how to say these things in a foreign language if this has not yet been covered in their existing curriculum. Fortunately, this existing knowledge in their own language can help them recognise, understand, and learn them more easily in a foreign language, in this case English. As they are students in the after prep year 9 of an upper secondary school, they are expected to know some basic vocabulary about ''personal life and well-being'' and also some necessary structures in English from the previous themes and/or years. These grammar items and vocabulary are revised during the ''Revision Programme'' at the beginning of the year and they can be used as a basis for learning the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme, so that the new grammatical elements in the current theme can be learnt easily.
bolumler.onDegerlendirme: It is assumed that these students in the after prep year 9 of an upper secondary school are ready to learn the concept of ''personal life and well-being with its components such as personal well-being with physical health (body and illnesses); personal well-being with mental and emotional health; personal well-being with social health'' cognitively, affectively, and socially since it is appropriate to their age and language level. Therefore, a contextual poster or a large picture could be provided for the students to remember and practise the items that they are related and previously learnt so that they can discuss the poster and/or the picture in pairs and write down what they remember. This session can help them revise all the related vocabulary and grammatical elements that they have already learnt from previous themes or from previous years as a preparatory practice. In this way, their performance can be evaluated in terms of how much they remember and how accurately they use these items to build their competence in the current theme. It can help the teacher decide what to emphasise, revise, and practise in order to facilitate the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme. (Their performance can be evaluated by rubrics, a rating scale, and /or a marking scheme during these practices.).
bolumler.zenginlestirme: Objective: To talk about personal well-being in English by using target vocabulary and target grammar. Activity 1: Well-being talk circles Students work in groups and the teacher gives real-life well-being scenarios to discuss solutions by using the target grammar. For example, in the scenario, ''A person used to suffer from depression but stopped attending therapy'', students discuss questions such as: What was their situation like in the past? What could they have done to feel better? and How can they cope now? They provide responses such as: ''They used to attend therapy regularly'', ''They could try different strategies to cope with their anxiety'', and ''They were struggling with loneliness when they stopped therapy''. This activity encourages collaborative problemsolving and accurate use of grammar structures. In the end, the teacher gives feedback on the selection and use of language including target vocabulary and target grammar. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
bolumler.destekleme: Objective: To describe personal well-being in English by using the target vocabulary. Activity 1: Fill it in right The teacher shows pictures of word groups such as ''suffer from, recover from, participate in, and talk to''. For example, a picture of someone ill with ''suffer from'' written on it or a person in a group with ''participate in''. Then, students receive a worksheet with sentences such as ''She suffered ___ loneliness'' or ''He participated ___ therapy''. They fill in the blanks, read their answers aloud, and the teacher gives feedback. In the end, students write one new sentence by using a preposition they learned. In the end, the teacher gives feedback on the selection and use of language including target vocabulary and target grammar. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
